topics.name: cmd_vel
topics.description: Walk command, normalized [-1, 1] like the Gamepad: linear.x forward, linear.y left, angular.z turn left — scaled by max_speed and max_yaw_rate. Zero, or nothing for cmd_timeout_s, stands still.

topics.name: imu
topics.description: An IMU Sensor on the body. Optional: with it the gait holds the body level, calibrating against its first reading (the robot standing as built).

topics.name: contact_fl
topics.description: The front-left foot's Contact Sensor. Optional: with it, a swing ends when the foot actually touches (lowering up to probe_depth further if it hasn't).

topics.name: contact_fr
topics.description: The front-right foot's Contact Sensor. Optional: with it, a swing ends when the foot actually touches (lowering up to probe_depth further if it hasn't).

topics.name: contact_rl
topics.description: The rear-left foot's Contact Sensor. Optional: with it, a swing ends when the foot actually touches (lowering up to probe_depth further if it hasn't).

topics.name: contact_rr
topics.description: The rear-right foot's Contact Sensor. Optional: with it, a swing ends when the foot actually touches (lowering up to probe_depth further if it hasn't).

topics.name: joint_commands
topics.description: Target positions for every leg joint. Wire it into each leg joint's Joint Controller (each takes its own joint).

forward.label: Forward
forward.description: Which world axis is the robot's front, as it stands built (Y is up). Names the legs front/rear and sets which way +linear.x walks.

flat_articulation.label: Robot Bodies
flat_articulation.description: Auto-injected: the robot's rigid bodies and DOF joints. The gait finds the four legs in it — each the joints from the base body to a body with a foot (a part with a `foot` connector).

cycle_s.label: Cycle Time
cycle_s.description: One full crawl cycle — all four legs stepped once.

step_height.label: Step Height
step_height.description: How high a swinging foot lifts.

crouch.label: Crouch
crouch.description: Standing height as a fraction of the leg's straight length (bent knees are stronger and have room to reach).

max_speed.label: Max Speed
max_speed.description: Walking speed at a full cmd_vel (linear.x or linear.y = 1).

max_yaw_rate.label: Max Turn Rate
max_yaw_rate.description: Turning rate at a full cmd_vel angular.z.

max_stride.label: Max Stride
max_stride.description: The longest step a foot takes in one cycle, whatever the speed.

shift_fraction.label: Shift Fraction
shift_fraction.description: Share of each leg's quarter cycle spent moving the body over the next support triangle before the leg lifts.

shift_gain.label: Shift Gain
shift_gain.description: How far the centre of mass moves toward the support triangle's centroid (1 = all the way).

com_offset_x.label: COM Offset Forward
com_offset_x.description: Where the centre of mass sits forward of the feet's centre (a heavy head, a battery at the back).

com_offset_y.label: COM Offset Left
com_offset_y.description: Where the centre of mass sits left of the feet's centre.

level_gain.label: Level Gain
level_gain.description: How fast the IMU levels the body (per second). 0 turns levelling off.

max_level_deg.label: Max Level Correction
max_level_deg.description: The most the feet are tilted to hold the body level.

probe_depth.label: Probe Depth
probe_depth.description: With contact sensors: how much further a foot reaches down for the ground before giving up.

probe_speed.label: Probe Speed
probe_speed.description: How fast a foot reaches down for the ground.

startup_s.label: Startup Time
startup_s.description: Time to crouch from the built pose into the standing pose before walking.

cmd_timeout_s.label: Command Timeout
cmd_timeout_s.description: Seconds without a cmd_vel before the robot stops.
